# For more information about build system see
# https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/latest/api-guides/build-system.html
# The following five lines of boilerplate have to be in your project's
# CMakeLists in this exact order for cmake to work correctly
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

set(PROJECT_VER "2.0.5.06")

# set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# Add this line to disable the specific warning
add_compile_options(-Wno-missing-field-initializers)

# Managed components are regenerated by the ESP-IDF component manager, so their
# warnings cannot be fixed in place.  esp_lvgl_port still calls the deprecated
# esp_lcd_touch_get_coordinates() API of esp_lcd_touch 2.x; silence that class
# of warning for the CMake/ninja side (the project's own sources are compiled
# by PlatformIO/SCons and keep reporting deprecations).
add_compile_options(-Wno-deprecated-declarations)

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(xiaozhi_vn)
